authorization_state: Parent explicitly requested a proposal only; no training or economic execution in this follow-up
claim_scope: One paired test of the frozen-GP CPD crypto policy adaptation, not exact replication or falsification of the paper

predecessor.preservation: No change to predecessor source, protocol, predictions, checkpoints or results; this is a separately counted scientific attempt

frozen_inputs.frozen_gp_and_scaler: Reuse exact predecessor FROZEN_TRAINING.json values after hash check; zero new GP or scaler fits
frozen_inputs.warmup: 2020 causal context, no backward fill, gaps reset; natural per-asset warmup retained
frozen_inputs.data_role: PROJECT_SEEN_DEVELOPMENT_HISTORY; inspected in attempt1; no pristine OOS or independent confirmatory inference
frozen_inputs.maturity: available[t+1] strictly less than split_end, equality purged; only train labels used in training
frozen_inputs.mask: At decision t use only completed-bar availability, finite past 63 inputs, valid causal volatility and past CP window; cash for currently ineligible assets, no inferred missing prices
frozen_inputs.missing_next_return: If any eligible decision-time asset lacks the realized next return, mark that block INVALID_MISSING_REALIZED_RETURN; do not set its return/exposure to zero or choose an ex-post eligibility mask
frozen_inputs.decision_mask_not_sample_index: Do not reuse predecessor core.py sample_index L110-L112 to form policy CASH eligibility: it checks future returns[t+1]. Keep training mature-label indexing separate from a new purely decision-time mask.

contrast.baseline: Same eight trend channels plus two zero channels
contrast.treatment: Same eight trends plus the exact frozen CP age/evidence channels
contrast.architecture: Stateless PyTorch LSTM(10,16), last hidden state, Linear(16,1) followed by tanh; fresh seeded initialization, no old checkpoint warm start
contrast.capacity_caveat: Equal nominal parameter axes and paired seeds do not equal active function capacity; added-channel effects cannot be separated from the additional active coefficients in this single pair
common_changes_from_attempt1: captured-return Sharpe loss replaces forecast MSE
unchanged_residual_gaps: last-step rather than time-distributed training output
overlapping rather than nonoverlapping training sequences
train-global scaling and fixed-grid frozen CPD rather than causal per-window online maximum-likelihood fitting
crypto and seen history rather than original 50 Pinnacle CLC futures

objective.known_at_decision: r[t+1] is a train-only outcome for learning and validation scoring, never an inference feature or oracle target
objective.loss: -sqrt(365) * mean(z) / sqrt(mean(z*z)-mean(z)^2+1e-9), pooled over the sampled asset-time endpoint rows
objective.variance: population moment; explicit epsilon=1e-9; stop on nonfinite loss/gradient/parameters
objective.note: This is a paper-aligned policy objective with a crypto calendar constant, not a native leveraged portfolio or a cost/funding objective

training.sampling: Exact paired seeded replacement endpoint minibatches and common sample rows; do not bootstrap dates into training or choose seeds
training.checkpoint_selection: Use update 1024 for all fits; no validation early stopping, best-seed or best-checkpoint selection
diagnostic_fields: last-minibatch preclip gradient norm and loss
sample identities and paired RNG/checkpoint SHA
training.convergence: No convergence assertion from a fixed update count; retain the trajectory. Heuristic tail drift is abs(full_train_Sharpe_1024-full_train_Sharpe_768)>0.02, reported per fit only; no budget extension or qualification rescue. Negative results remain budget-limited if drift/gradients do not stabilize

scoring.ensemble: Equal arithmetic mean of the three seed positions at each eligible asset/date; no seed selection
scoring.date_portfolio_proxy: U[t]=sum_a(decision_mask[t,a]*z[t,a])/5, fixed CORE5 denominator; currently unavailable asset allocations remain cash; eligibility cannot depend on realized return
metrics: Captured-return mean/std and downside deviation; raw exposure/turnover diagnostics, not native NAV or net drawdown
MSE and rank IC only as diagnostics, not necessary gates
positions and causal masks saved for later economic adapter audit
scoring.zero_cost_label: RAW_CAPTURED_RETURN_POLICY_PROBE; no fills, funding, capital conservation, leverage, charged terminal closure or net PnL/APR claim
gates_all_required: Ensemble portfolio-proxy Sharpe increment positive in at least 2 of 3 fixed blocks
Aggregate portfolio-proxy Sharpe increment positive in at least 2 of 3 paired seeds
Aggregate ensemble portfolio-proxy Sharpe increment positive
Paired moving-block bootstrap 95% lower bound of aggregate ensemble portfolio-proxy Sharpe increment positive
scoring.aggregate: Compute the nonlinear Sharpe once from all valid chronological block daily proxy returns; do not average block Sharpe ratios

bootstrap.scheme: Draw the same contiguous calendar-date indices for both arms, jointly across all five assets; resample within each fixed block without bridging purged boundaries/gaps; recompute both nonlinear Sharpe values per draw. Report invalid/degenerate draws, never replace NaN by zero
bootstrap.ci: 2.5/97.5 percentiles; if an input block is invalid or any bootstrap score is nonfinite, gate is INVALID rather than PASS

scoring.inference_scope: Conditional resampling uncertainty on seen history; no fresh OOS confidence claim and no attribution of any gain specifically to profitable fast reversion
scoring.stop: One attempt. Gate failure or resource/data failure stops without seed, horizon, CP window, recipe or update extension
scoring.sharpe_definition: sqrt(365)*mean(U)/std(U,ddof=0); zero or nonfinite variance is INVALID. Optimizer epsilon is not inserted into scored Sharpe.

economics.reason: The requested correction is a signal/policy probe. Native economic inputs, source/units, decision-to-fill latency and runner binding have not been certified for this policy.
economics.possible_follow_on: Only after explicit future start, valid incremental policy evidence and a separate concrete native-input freeze: at most one paired trend/CP shared-wallet comparison with existing actual fees/slippage/signed funding/masks/risk and charged terminal closure

resource_budget.launcher: Reuse unchanged conservative launch.sh guard; no bypass
resource_budget.cost_estimate: 6*1024=6144 gradient updates, four times attempt1 update count; estimated 1-5 minutes CPU for training/scoring based on the earlier 13.018-second complete attempt. Estimate is not benchmarked; data reuse and additional diagnostics alter cost. Hard stop is 1200 seconds, no automatic extension.

Verify reused artifact/source hashes and strictly train-only sample/maturity/mask axes
Focused tests for Sharpe moments, tanh bounds, pairing, mask-before-outcome, nonlinear joint-date bootstrap and unchanged original artifacts
